title: Glowmarkt Smart Meter Consumption Leaderboard
dataSources: SolarEdge/Enphase production (`solaredge:power`, `enphase:production`), Tesla Powerwall (`powerwall:aggregate`), smart-meter P1/DSMR (`dsmr:telegram`), Emporia Vue circuits (`emporia:circuit`), Sense (`sense:device`).
app: Solar inverters (SolarEdge/Enphase/Fronius/Growatt), Tesla Powerwall, smart meters (P1/DSMR, Emporia Vue, Sense) via vendor APIs and MQTT to HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=glowmarkt:reading consumption_kwh=*
| stats sum(consumption_kwh) as total_value, avg(consumption_kwh) as avg_value by fuel_type
| sort - total_value
description: Ranks fuel values by total and average consumption across Glowmarkt reading events.
value: Leaderboards help you see which people, devices, places, or projects dominate the signal.
implementation: Ingest numeric `consumption_kwh` values for each Glowmarkt reading event and review total and average consumption by fuel.
visualization: Table of entities ranked by total consumption.
grandmaExplanation: It will remind which fuel shows the biggest consumption numbers in your Glowmarkt reading data.
